arxiv-2101-07180.title: Phase transitions and noise sensitivity on the Poisson space via stopping sets and decision trees
arxiv-2101-07180.creator: Günter Last, Giovanni Peccatiabel=e2, mark]giovanni.peccati@uni.lu, D. Yogeshwaranabel=e3, mark]d.yogesh@isibang.ac.in
arxiv-2101-07180.description: Abstract Proofs of sharp phase transition and noise sensitivity in percolation have been significantly simplified by the use of randomized algorithms, via the OSSS inequality (proved by O’Donnell, Saks, Schramm and Servedio in [ 60 ] ) and the Schramm-Steif inequality for the Fourier-Walsh coefficients of functions defined on the Boolean hypercube (see [ 70 ] ).

arxiv-2208-13378.title: The Effect of Duschinskii Rotations on Spin-Dependent Electron Transfer Dynamics
arxiv-2208-13378.creator: Suraj S. Chandran, Yanze Wu, Joseph E. Subotnik
arxiv-2208-13378.description: Abstract We investigate spin-dependent electron transfer in the presence of a Duschinskii rotation. In particular, we propagate dynamics for a two-level model system for which spin-orbit coupling introduces an interstate coupling of the form e i ​ W ​ x e^{iWx} , which is both position( x x )-dependent and complex-valued.

arxiv-2301-05078.title: Stratification des variétés de Hilbert en présence de ramification
arxiv-2301-05078.creator: Diego Berger
arxiv-2301-05078.description: Abstract Résumé. Dans ce papier on étudie la géométrie de la fibre spéciale des modèles de Pappas-Rapoport des variétés de Shimura dans le cas Hilbert. Plus précisément on prouve que la stratification induite par le polygone de Hodge est une bonne stratification, ce qui est faux dans le cas Hilbert-Siegel pour g ≥ 2 g\geq 2 .

arxiv-2401-09226.title: Characterizing and visualizing the direct injection of hydrogen into high-pressure argon and nitrogen environments
arxiv-2401-09226.creator: Max Peters, Noud Maes, Nico Dam, Jeroen van Oijen
arxiv-2401-09226.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Max Peters, Noud Maes, Nico Dam, Jeroen van Oijen. Using argon as the working fluid in an internal combustion engine holds the potential of substantially enhancing thermal efficiency because of its high specific heat ratio. Burning hydrogen, not with air but with pure oxygen, in a closed-loop argon power cycle would lead to an emission-free exhaust composition, effectively containing only water and argon, which can be separated by condensation.

arxiv-2410-17528.title: Can Constrained Quantum Annealing Be Effective in Noisy Quantum Annealers?
arxiv-2410-17528.creator: Ryoya Igata, Myonsok I, Yuya Seki, Yuta Mizuno, Shohei Watabe
arxiv-2410-17528.description: Abstract We investigate the performance of penalty-based quantum annealing (PQA) and constrained quantum annealing (CQA) in solving the graph partitioning problem under various noise models, including depolarizing, bit-flip, and phase-flip noise. We found that even in the absence of noise, the relative superiority of PQA or CQA is highly problem-dependent.

arxiv-2508-10574.title: Federated Learning Over LoRa Networks: Simulator Design and Performance Evaluation
arxiv-2508-10574.creator: Anshika Singh, Siddhartha S. Borkotoky
arxiv-2508-10574.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL) over long-range (LoRa) low-power wide area networks faces unique challenges due to limited bandwidth, interference, and strict duty-cycle constraints. We develop a Python-based simulator that integrates and extends the Flower and LoRaSim frameworks to evaluate centralized FL over LoRa networks.

pmc-12987259.title: An Energy Detection Algorithm with Clustering-Based False Alarm Suppression for Magnetic Anomaly Detection
pmc-12987259.creator: Jinghua Yu, Changping Du, Xiang Peng
pmc-12987259.description: To overcome the limitations of Orthonormal Basis Function (OBF) methods in magnetic anomaly detection, including high false alarm rates and ambiguous target localization due to background noise, this paper introduces a high-confidence detection algorithm based on hierarchical clustering with an optimal cut height.

pmc-13052013.title: Lifesaving Compassionate‐Use of Sotatercept in a 12‐Year‐old With Idiopathic Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
pmc-13052013.creator: Weronika Pelczar‐Płachta, Rafał Surmacz, Waldemar Bobkowski
pmc-13052013.description: Pediatric idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension (IPAH) refractory to maximal medical therapy is associated with high morbidity and mortality, and therapeutic options remain limited. We describe a 12‐year‐old girl with end‐stage IPAH who developed acute decompensated right heart failure despite triple combination therapy, including high‐dose prostacyclin. Escalation to intravenous epoprostenol failed to result in clinical or hemodynamic improvement.

pmc-13373790.title: Impaired consolidation of spatial memory during sleep in patients with leucine-rich glioma-inactivated 1-associated limbic encephalitis
pmc-13373790.creator: Julius Rave, Annika Hanert, Younes Adam Tabi, Yasmin Fiedler, Sarah Philippen, Oliver Granert, Frank Leypoldt, Jan Born, Andrea Burgalossi, Robby Schönfeld, Carsten Finke, Thorsten Bartsch
pmc-13373790.description: Sleep promotes the systems consolidation of hippocampus (HC)-dependent spatial memories by reprocessing of previously encoded hippocampal representations. Hippocampal reprocessing involves pattern separation and pattern completion as central hippocampal functions performed by the dentate gyrus (DG) and cornu ammonis region 3 (CA3), respectively.

pmc-13502507.title: Associations of Physical Activity and Sleep with Depression, Anxiety, and Loneliness Among U.S. Adults: A Population-Based Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13502507.creator: Samuel Ofei-Dodoo, Yousaf Khan, Ibrahim Touffaha, Divya Natesan, Hayrettin Okut, Claire Richardson, Isabelle Bevis, Mark White
pmc-13502507.description: IntroductionPhysical activity, strength training, and sleep are important determinants of mental health. The authors of this study examined the associations of these lifestyle behaviors with emotional health outcomes among U.S. adults.MethodsAuthors conducted a cross-sectional analysis of data from the 2024 Health Information National Trends Survey® 7, a nationally representative survey of U.S. adults aged ≥18 years (N = 7278).

pmc-13613045.title: Ethics of Care in Nursing: Protocol for a Qualitative Systematic Review and Best-Fit Framework Synthesis
pmc-13613045.creator: Wimonpan Sungsakul, Sungworn Ngudgratoke, Nalinee Na Nakorn, Anusorn Koedsri
pmc-13613045.description: BackgroundEthics of care lies at the heart of the nursing profession. Grounded in the work of Gilligan and Tronto, it emphasizes relationships and responsiveness to the needs of those receiving care. Although Tronto’s framework specifies 5 elements of care, no systematic synthesis has yet examined how each element is expressed through observable behavioral indicators in the nursing context.
